MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The finish nails look related to my recent purchases, but their length and gauge serve a different purpose from my framing nails; I would need to confirm the task and tool compatibility.",
    "Locking nuts do not complement the wood screws and nails I recently bought, because those fasteners do not require nuts.",
    "Glue, epoxy and adhesive strips require a specific repair or mounting need; buying screws and anchors does not mean I currently need these alternatives.",
    "Cutting wheels, a pressure gauge, a thermometer and electronic cleaner suggest tasks that my recent purchases do not establish.",
    "Ten tubes of super glue feel excessive without a clear use, even though I have bought other supplies in large quantities."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat a broad connection to tools and repair supplies as enough evidence that I need an item now.",
    "They treat different fastening methods as interchangeable, although nails, screws, nuts and adhesives solve different problems."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My nail purchases include specific lengths, diameters, collation angles and styles; those details matter more than simply recommending another nail product.",
    "My recent screws and drywall anchors suggest particular fastening needs, rather than a general interest in every workshop supply.",
    "My latest purchase was replacement vacuum bags identified by compatible types, which suggests a separate household replenishment need.",
    "I choose supplies when they fit a concrete task; a related product alone does not give me a reason to buy it."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in practical supplies but generalized beyond the specific tasks and compatibility requirements that would make me choose something now."
}
